note: Canonical asset registry for Canton Payment Streams. Per-asset routing (admin party, Scan endpoint URL, wallet-gateway URL, token-standard API URL, capability flags) is used by the SDK and adoption-metrics tooling. Generated by scripts/build-asset-registry.mjs and committed after review. Assets route the CIP-56 V2 lane once they advertise V2 in supportedApis; CC and USDCx route the transitional V1 lane (allocationsV1) until then per CIP-0112 §5 — the flags flip with no code change.

meta.note: Test asset for V2-DevNet probes. Not for Mainnet.

meta.source: Amulet instrument id and DSO admin per Digital Asset / Splice docs (docs.digitalasset.com, docs.sync.global).
meta.note: Live on MainNet on the V1 token standard. Per CIP-0112 §5 Amulet is expected to publish V2 interfaces; when supportedApis advertises V2, flip allocationsV2/transferEventsV2 — no code change.
meta.adminResolution: The DSO party is network-specific and the published value is a documented reference. Confirm for your target network: GET {scanEndpointUrl}/api/scan/v0/dso-party-id.
meta.tokenStandardApiNote: Amulet's registry API is served by Scan at the bare host; choice-context endpoints live under /registry/allocations/v1/..., not under /api/scan.
meta.walletGatewayResolution: Deployment-specific — point walletGatewayUrl at your operator's wallet gateway.

meta.standard: CIP-56 V1 (transitional; Circle xReserve Registry Utility token)
meta.source: USDCx instrument id, per-network registrar admin, and registry base URL per Circle xReserve / Digital Asset docs (docs.digitalasset.com/usdc/xreserve, docs.digitalasset.com/integrate/devnet/usdcx-support).
meta.note: USDCx is Circle's USDC on Canton via xReserve. V1 token standard today; flip V2 flags when it advertises V2.
